A related but distinct fact bearing on the numerator: FACT [Property, Plant and Equipment note]: \"Construction in progress(2) 4,937 | 3,444\" and \"Includes costs related to equipment not placed into service of $3.40 billion as of May 29, 2025 and $3.10 billion as of August 29, 2024.\" INFERENCE: $4,937m of construction in progress and $3.40bn of equipment not in service sit in the asset base without yet charging depreciation to earnings, while the equity funding them is already in the denominator; the direction of the net effect on the ratio cannot be determined from the bundle.", "settling_item": "The significant accounting policies note showing capitalisation thresholds for the current and prior year (i.e. E-09), plus the in-service date schedule for the $3.40bn of equipment not yet placed into service."}, {"number": 11, "status": "present", "evidence": "FACT [MD&A Consolidated Results]: gross margin \"3,508 | 38% | 2,963 | 37% | 1,832 | 27% | 9,819 | 38% | 2,876 | 17%\" (Q3 FY25, Q2 FY25, Q3 FY24, 9M FY25, 9M FY24). FACT [E-04, ng.measure, status not_found]: \"Searched the full 10-Q: no non-GAAP measure is presented.\" FACT [declared absent inputs]: no <computed_metrics> block exists in this bundle; \"peer_set_figures\" and \"reference_class_base_rates\" are likewise declared absent. INFERENCE: the company states no definition of return_on_equity because it does not present the measure at all; there is therefore no definition to test against the standard one, and no reported level for the preceding eleven mechanisms to be measured against. The raw inputs a standard definition would use are present \u2014 FACT [Balance Sheets]: \"Total equity | 50,748 | 45,131\"; FACT [Statements of Operations]: \"Net income (loss) | $1,885 | $332 | $5,338 | $(109)\" \u2014 but combining them is arithmetic I am not permitted to perform.", "settling_item": "A computed return_on_equity metric with its stated numerator (net income attributable to common, before or after any adjustment), its denominator (period-end versus average equity), and the period over which it is struck."}], "company_definition_quote": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE \u2014 needed: the company's own statement of return on equity. why: the bundle contains no such statement; E-04 records that \"no non-GAAP measure is presented\" in the 10-Q, and no ROE figure, formula or narrative appears in the filing, the evidence blocks, the D-02 trail or the annual history. The nearest quotable items are the two raw inputs: \"Total equity | 50,748 | 45,131\" (Balance Sheets, 2025-05-29 vs 2024-08-29) and \"Net income (loss) | $1,885 | $332 | $5,338 | $(109)\" (Statements of Operations). would_change: if the company defined ROE on average equity with GAAP net income, mechanism 12 would be \"absent\"; if it defined it on an adjusted numerator or a tangible-equity denominator, mechanism 12 would be \"present\" and would need sizing before any of the other eleven could be read.", "fraction_of_level_accounted": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on the fraction \u2014 needed: a computed return_on_equity level (and an ROA or ROIC figure beside it). why: the bundle has no <computed_metrics> block and the company never presents the measure, so there is no level to apportion and I am barred from deriving one; any percentage range I stated would be manufactured. What the evidence does support, as direction rather than fraction: mechanism 11 (cyclical position) dominates \u2014 the same nine-month period moved from $(109)m net loss to $5,338m net income and from a 17% to a 38% gross margin on a \"high-40% range increase\" in DRAM average selling prices, against a company-published five-year DRAM range topping out at \"plus low-teen\"; mechanism 3 (tax) is second and is sized in the filing at $623m of nine-month tax-provision benefit sitting inside that $5,338m, with the company guiding its own rate to \"high-teens percentage range\" for 2026; mechanism 1 (leverage) is third, present on $15,541m of debt plus $1.02bn of executed-but-uncommenced lease obligations, and unmeasurable without an ROA. Mechanisms 2, 4, 6, 7 and 8 are absent on the evidence \u2014 the equity base grew, no asset-sale gains hit earnings, operating cash flow ($11,795m) exceeded net income, trade receivables were flat on 50% revenue growth, and inventory fell while cost of sales rose \u2014 and that is a real finding, not an omission.", "answer": "HEADLINE: the metric under examination is not in the bundle. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE \u2014 needed: a computed return_on_equity figure for any period. why: there is no <computed_metrics> block in this bundle at all, and Micron presents no return measure in the 10-Q (E-04: \"no non-GAAP measure is presented\"); the raw inputs exist (\"Total equity | 50,748 | 45,131\"; \"Net income (loss) | $1,885 | $332 | $5,338 | $(109)\") but combining them is arithmetic I am not permitted to do. would_change: if ROE were supplied and high while ROA was also high, mechanism 1 falls away and mechanism 11 carries the answer alone; if ROE were high while ROA was modest, mechanism 1 becomes co-dominant with 11.\n\nSubject to that, the enumeration is not evenly balanced and the reader should notice where it concentrates. Three mechanisms are PRESENT: cyclical position (11), the tax rate inside the numerator (3), and leverage (1). Five are ABSENT on positive evidence rather than on silence: the denominator is growing, not shrinking \u2014 no repurchases in the nine months, treasury stock unchanged at $(7,852)m, goodwill unchanged at $1,150m, equity up from $45,131m to $50,748m (2); no asset sale or revaluation reached earnings, with fair-value hedge movements offsetting within the quarter (4); the earnings improvement shows up in cash, with nine-month operating cash flow of $11,795m against $5,338m of net income and quarterly operating cash flow rising through the year to $4,609m (6); trade receivables were flat at $5,492m versus $5,419m while nine-month revenue rose 50% (7); and inventory fell to $8,727m from $8,875m while nine-month cost of goods sold rose to $16,244m from $14,485m (8). Four are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and three of those share one cause: E-09 was skipped, so provision releases (5), estimate and presentation changes (9) and capitalisation shifts (10) cannot be tested against anything except management's own assertion that \"there have been no changes to our significant accounting policies\" \u2014 an assertion accompanied by an unquantified \"certain reclassifications have been made to prior-period amounts\". The fourth (12) is definitional and unanswerable because the company states no definition.\n\nThe concentration matters. The forensic risk here is not accrual manipulation \u2014 the cash-conversion, receivables and inventory tests all come back clean, and they are the tests that usually catch it. The risk is that the level is a cycle artefact. Gross margin of 38% is the highest in the four periods the filing discloses, against 17% for the prior-year nine months and a 2023 in which the company \"recorded aggregate charges of $1.83 billion to write down the carrying value of our inventories\"; free cash flow in the annual history was negative in four of nine fiscal years (FY2016 \u22122,403,000,000; FY2020 \u221269,209,856; FY2023 \u22126,325,000,000; FY2024 \u2212354,404,839 USD); and frozen J-01 classifies the business as \"cyclical_commodity\" with J-07 placing it \"mid\" cycle, runner-up \"late\". Second in size is the tax line: the effective rate is 11.1% for the quarter and 11.5% for the nine months, with $623m of nine-month benefit attributed to incentive arrangements that \"expire, in whole or in part, at various dates through 2034\", and the company's own guidance is \"high-teens percentage range\" for 2026. Leverage is real but its nine-month direction worked against the mechanism \u2014 debt rose from $13,397m to $15,541m while equity rose by more.\n\nTwo things I will not claim. I cannot say what fraction of the level these account for, because there is no level. And I cannot rule out the E-09 mechanisms; I can only name what would settle each, which I have done for all ten non-absent entries.\n\nWHAT WOULD MOVE ME: a full-cycle return_on_equity series showing the FY2023 trough reading \u2014 if the trough level were close to the current one, mechanism 11 would drop from present to insufficient_evidence and the whole enumeration would come back nearly clean; if the trough reading were negative or near zero, mechanism 11 becomes the answer and the other eleven are detail."}
